name: Kit Release Skill
purpose: The runtime and kit release ritual: bump Studio.version with one changelog line, update catalogue versions, run the numeric gates under the host lock, kit audits, tests and governance, release to every project with studio.py upgrade --all, prove the release and record it.
capabilities: Ordered ten-step checklist with exact commands for Windows and macOS
Rules for other sessions' projects, legacy-profile hashing and host honesty
Stop rule when the tree's versions disagree with the last handoff

compatibility.notes: Written and trialled on the Windows host (2026-11-25); the same commands run on macOS with .venv/bin/python.

approval_evidence: Encodes the release done by hand in every 2026-11-19..25 Tibi session; trialled for the 1.15.0 release on Windows (no render-host evidence).
